narr: Slow moving showers and storms moved over portions of the Ozarks that had received multiple rounds of heavy rainfall over the preceding week. This lead to flooding on several low water crossings and caused some rivers to reach minor flood stage.
ev: State Highway CC at Elkhorn Creek was flooded and impassable.
State Highway Aa at Buffalo Creek was flooded and impassable.
lsr: State Highway AA is closed due to flooding.
State Highway CC was closed due to flooding.
